title: 📍 Navigation History: Quick Access to Recently Visited Pages in BC 🧭
summary: Navigation History is a feature that automatically tracks every page and record you visit in Business Central, letting you quickly reopen them, view your complete chronological history, and manage entries with cleanup actions. It uses four AL objects (enum, table, page, codeunit) with event subscribers to log visits with minimal performance impact.
key_points: Automatically records all page visits and record opens with date/time ordering for quick access
Distinguishes between list page visits and individual card record opens with visual identification
Supports reopening any historical entry with a single click and includes cleanup actions like delete entries older than 30 days
Implemented using event subscribers on page events (OnOpenPageEvent for lists, OnAfterGetCurrRecordEvent for cards)

quotes.text: Automatically recording each navigation adds additional time, although without much impact on performance.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important caveat showing the solution has minimal performance overhead despite tracking all page visits
